answer: Sybils who wander in cheaply face escalating deposit slashing whenever peers flag duplicate behavior, so forging a thousand fake identities costs a thousand forfeitable bonds. Agents stake a bonded deposit of shale tokens to register, and each identity must solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its wallet. Any fable of free entry collapses under that arithmetic, since honest participants recover stakes while attackers lose them. From qwe0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
